Shell Nav

Move a reader between the sections of a framed brief: tabs in the shell bar on wide screens, and a menu button with a dropdown under the bar on narrow ones.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1BarFlex row, 52px tall, wordmark left, tabs or menu button rightnone; sits on the shell surface
2WordmarkKit 38, label sizecyan, text-secondary
3Current labelNarrow only: the current section name replaces the wordmark in the barcyan, sans semibold
4TabSans, body size, semibold, 44px target, 2px underline when selectedtext-secondary, selected cyan

Usage

Use it when

  • A framed brief or hub has 3 to 6 sections a reader moves between (the cia and myally shell).
  • The page needs one section per view on desktop and a jump list on a phone.

Do not use it when

  • A single long page with no sections; use headings and the reader's scroll.
  • More than 6 sections; group them first.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
tabs[]listyesEach tab: label, data-target (the section it opens), optional pill text.
data-menu-belownumber (px)noWidth below which the tabs fold into the menu; the Gravity page uses 1024.
onPick(target, isMenu)callbacknoThe page shows the section for a tab, or scrolls to it from the menu.

Access

  • Wide: role=tablist with role=tab, aria-selected, roving tab index and arrow keys.
  • Narrow: the list drops its tab roles and becomes plain buttons, each reachable with Tab; the current one carries aria-current, and the selection comes back as aria-selected when the tabs return.
  • The menu button is a real <button> with aria-expanded and an aria-label; opening moves focus into the menu, Escape closes it and returns focus to the button.
  • Selection reads without colour: underline on tabs, inset bar on menu rows, and the state is exposed to assistive tech.
  • Reduced motion drops the icon morph and the menu fade.
